findings: B70 exposes compute/copy ordinal0 and copy-only ordinal1; copy-only maximum fill pattern1 byte.
Unitrace engine_ordinal is copied from the original command-list descriptor; label does not expose internal driver copy offload.
V2 requests offload as a hint; driver can ignore per operation. No forced-offload/driver flag is introduced in this experiment.
DPCT queue helper adds enable_profiling under a compilation macro; current transfer queue inherits it.
Transfer copied/used events are dependency signals; prefill timers query compute/peer events, not transfer events.
decision: Test suppression of unused transfer-queue profiling. Avoid selecting a forced native BCS queue from the ambiguous track labels.
limits: Neither track labels nor instrumented overlaps prove physical engine utilization or an unprofiled bottleneck.
